Don't mess with electronics you don't understand.
column2: 不懂的電子產品不要亂碰。

column1: The label is hard to read, but I think it says something about a rhesus monkey.
column2: 標籤很難讀，但我想上面寫的是跟獼猴有關的東西。

column1: I'm not putting anything in there.
column2: 我才不要往裡面放東西。

column1: Gosh, I hope this isn't like the primitive, dangerous microwave ovens of my century.
column2: 天啊，希望這不像我那個世紀那種原始又危險的微波爐。

column1: Those things could really pop a hamster good.
column2: 那種東西真的能把倉鼠爆得很徹底。

column1: That was fun, but only because this is the 22nd century.
column2: 那很好玩，但那是因為現在是二十二世紀。

column1: You see, kids who put hamsters in microwaves back where I'm from^\255\003^get taken away from their parents^\255\003^and put up for adoption!
column2: 你知道嗎，在我來的地方，把倉鼠放進微波爐的小孩^\255\003^會被從父母身邊帶走^\255\003^然後送去給人領養！

column1: He was scratching his back on the fence, I think.
column2: 我想他剛剛在用柵欄抓背。

column1: I think it looks beautiful just the way it is.
column2: 我覺得它現在這樣就很美。

column1: Gee, I hope that's not lead-based paint.
column2: 唉，希望那不是含鉛油漆。

column1: I can't get to it up there.
Somehow I don't think that will get him down.
column2: 我總覺得那樣弄不下他來。

column1: You haven't seen a gangly human around, have you?
column2: 你有沒有看到一個瘦長的人類？

column1: I like what they've done with the place.
column2: 我喜歡他們把這裡弄成的樣子。

column1: I don't think there's enough to cover the whole thing.
column2: 我看份量不夠塗滿整個東西。

column1: This doesn't seem like the best place to start a panic.
column2: 這裡好像不是製造恐慌的好地方。

column1: He doesn't need a touch up.
What, and ruin all that hard work?
column2: 什麼，然後毀掉那些辛苦成果？

column1: It's hard enough to hold on to him as it is.
Well, what do we have here?

column2: 看來是隻義肢齧齒動物！

column1: It's as if he'd rather scratch himself than play with this adorable rodent!
column2: 他好像寧可抓癢也不想跟這隻可愛的齧齒動物玩！

column1: Looks like a paint-by-numbers picture of sushi.
column2: 看起來像按號碼填色的壽司畫。

column1: I still don't understand how they can eat through a sucker.
column2: 我還是不懂他們怎麼能用吸盤吃東西。

column1: It's a comprehensive though poorly rendered diagram of the working parts of a tentacle.
column2: 這是一張觸手身體構造的完整圖解，只是畫得很爛。

column1: I might get ashes on my killer t-shirt.
column2: 我可能會把菸灰弄到我的酷 T 上。

column1: They've got the spleen mixed up with the liver.
column2: 他們把脾臟跟肝臟搞混了。

column1: Oh, I've got plenty of those at home.
column2: 喔，這種東西我家一大堆。

column1: There might be a smoke alarm in here.
column2: 這裡可能裝了煙霧警報器。

column1: It wouldn't be as much fun as the real thing.
column2: 那不會比真的來得有趣。

column1: `Licensed to treat tentacles for the betterment of the tentacle race.`
column2: `茲核准為觸手族之福祉診治觸手。`

column1: I shouldn't.  He paid a lot of money for that.
column2: 我不該這麼做。他花了不少錢弄那個。

column1: `Licensed to euthanize humans for the betterment of the tentacle race.`
column2: `茲核准為觸手族之福祉安樂死人類。`

column1: Well, well, what have we here?
Are you gonna use your scalpel?
There's nothing wrong with you, human.
Well, I'm late for the show.\255\003I'll send your keeper back for you.
column2: 我趕比賽要遲到了。\255\003我會叫你的管理員回來接你。

column1: Now, why would I want to ruin the only entertainment these poor, wretched humans have?
column2: 我幹嘛要毀掉這些可憐悲慘的人類唯一的娛樂？

column1: Hey, THEY can cheat.  YOU can't.
column2: 欸，他們可以作弊。你不行。

column1: That's what I think of you, humans.
column2: 這就是我對你們人類的看法。

column1: How's that for a blast from the past, eh?
column2: 這算不算是懷舊大放送，嗄？
我看他們兩個都在作弊。

column1: I can't kill my fellow inmates!\255\003I don't even know them yet.
column2: 我不能殺我的獄友！\255\003我都還不認識他們。

column1: I don't want to start any fights I can't win.
column2: 我不想挑起自己打不贏的架。

column1: I don't think they're paying much attention.
column2: 我看他們沒怎麼在注意。

column1: Best not bother them.\255\003They're busy cheating.
column2: 最好別打擾他們。\255\003他們忙著作弊。

column1: I think it controls the force field.
Now I am the jailer, and YOU^\255\003^YOU, kitty, are my PRISONER!!!\255\003Ah-HA HA HA!!!
column2: 現在我是獄卒，而你^\255\003^你，小貓咪，是我的囚犯！！！\255\003啊——哈哈哈！！！

column1: Get away from that.  That's MY job.
column2: 離那個遠一點。那是我的工作。

column1: Oh, here I go out the door^\255\003Oh, I do so enjoy these freedoms that my forefathers fought and died for^
column2: 喔，我要走出這扇門囉^\255\003喔，我真享受先祖們拋頭顱灑熱血換來的這些自由啊^

column1: Congratulations, kitty!\255\003You've saved humanity with your repulsive appearance!
column2: 恭喜你，小貓咪！\255\003你用你噁心的外表拯救了人類！

column1: I think I've had enough fun with Mr. Kitty.
I just want to pat his little head.
column2: 我只是想摸摸他的小腦袋。
